picks.title: Figma embraces new AI paradigm but expresses reservations
picks.excerpt: Figma co-founder Dylan Field called MCP incomplete and tilted toward big AI labs even as Figma added 20 MCP partners (Notion, ClickUp, Linear) at its India event. Repost of hacks.gr; original reporting by TechCrunch (2026-10-20).
picks.rationale: Hard Figma news: 20 new MCP partners (Notion, ClickUp, Linear) announced at its India event, plus Dylan Field's public critique of MCP. No Figma MCP partner story appears in the 30-day history. The card is a repost, so enrichment should cite TechCrunch's 10-20 report as the original.

picks.title: Europe's Industrial Leaders Reinvent Engineering and Manufacturing With NVIDIA
picks.excerpt: At GTC Berlin, Autodesk brings PhysicsNeMo and Warp into NavPack integrated with Autodesk Alias so Bentley designers can predict vehicle performance with simulation-trained AI, and Dassault's CATIA/SIMULIA AI agents design and virtually test car doors.
picks.rationale: New GTC Berlin announcements: physics AI built into Autodesk Alias for Bentley's designers, and CATIA agents that design and test car doors. This is a separate event from the 10-14 RTX Spark, 10-18 Adobe x NVIDIA and 10-10 SimReady cards.

picks.title: Even designers are now using AI to code Windows 11, and Microsoft says "we're only getting started"
picks.excerpt: Microsoft's Diego Baca says Windows 11 designers are now making code fixes themselves with AI as Search, Run and Photos are rebuilt in native UI - an in-house design-org AX case. Off-list outlet (no on-list coverage).
picks.rationale: A concrete workflow shift at a major design org: Windows 11 designers now ship their own code fixes with AI. That is a named, on-the-record case, not an essay.

picks.title: I built a Claude Code skill that de-slops AI-generated web design
picks.excerpt: design-slop-skill is an open Claude Code skill that deterministically detects the 'AI look' in generated pages (huge radii, glassmorphism, red-purple gradients, dark-only, 64px centered heroes) and rewrites them toward human-crafted defaults.
picks.rationale: A new open-source tool that designers can install tomorrow. It flags the 'AI look' in generated pages and rewrites it toward human-crafted defaults. It is a different release from Anthropic's frontend-design skill (10-09) and from the 9-30 de-slopify essay.

picks.title: Food Delivery App Apologizes for AI-Generated Menu Photos Showing Bacon Floating in Soda
picks.excerpt: Just Eat apologized after inaccurate AI-generated menu photos, including bacon and eggs floating in a soda, appeared on its app - a brand-imagery cautionary tale for AI-made food photography. Off-list outlet; date/image from PetaPixel RSS (page 403s).
picks.rationale: A real brand incident and public apology over AI-generated product imagery, a direct QA warning for designers who ship AI visuals at scale. It is unrelated to the 10-20 PetaPixel false-memories study.
